about: ACE-Step 1.5 cue spec, round 3: battle metal at a tempo per level, symphonic-metal intros and outros. Each level keeps its original motif (tools/music_motifs.py); tools/music_guide.py renders each cue's arrangement at the level's exact tempo (an integer number of samples per bar) to a guide, and ACE-Step re-performs it audio-to-audio (acestep15-a2a.json) with a genre take of the same level and style as ReferenceTimbreAudio. Marches, the alien victory, the cackle and the menu are unchanged from round 2 (120 BPM). Prompts describe genre traits only; they never name a song, band, game or composer.
common_tags: instrumental, no vocals, original video game battle soundtrack, 4/4, steady tempo

kinds.loop: whole file loops; length = beats exactly; the first crossfade_s blend the continuation into the start so the wrap is continuous
kinds.tail: plays `beats` once, then the appended copy of its last bar loops (loopStart..loopEnd) until the next cue
kinds.oneshot: plays `beats` once and ends with a fade over `fade_s`
kinds.sprite: accent sprite: one slot of `slot_beats` per accent (dive, laststand, hatch, reinforce), played on demand
kinds.reference: text-to-music genre take used only as the timbre reference of its group; not shipped
